stem.text: Compound X, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CH(CHO)CH}_3$, is heated under reflux with an excess of acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ to form compound Y.
Both X and Y are separately warmed with Fehling’s solution and the observations noted.

A.text: Both X and Y give a red precipitate.

B.text: Only X gives a red precipitate.

C.text: Only Y gives a red precipitate.

D.text: Neither X nor Y gives a red precipitate.
